ln:4463819084.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Role Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Development Lead to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable trading control systems that power Standard Chartered’ s digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with DEV, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Application Design, Architecture
  • Software Development
  • Leadership

Other Skills

  • AI

Qualifications

  • Key Experiences:
  • 8+ years of experience in development with strong Java expertise, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to mentor and lead a team of engineers, fostering an environment of innovation and continuous learning.
  • Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory): Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Language: English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

 Business: CIB GPS IT

Job ID: 57188

Principal Responsibilities

  • Organize AP/EMEA Project accordance with the mission and goals of Global Payments Solutions IT
  • Manage the project approach and build stakeholder buy in around the project plan, commitments and changes
  • Support a team with a global array of talents and responsibilities to manage delivery proactively, balancing scope, schedule, resourcing, dependencies and communications
  • Manage, monitor and report progress, issues, dependencies, risks to the global program management, internal stakeholders and steering committees. Make recommendations to influence decision making in order to maintain progress towards delivery and benefits realization
  • Enforce process discipline and improvements in areas of expertise, such as, disciplined agile software delivery, production support processes, and continuous DevOps pipeline development
  • Lead and Drive the development and help running of the program management office or project management practice
  • Ensure adherence to standard controls and drive teams to achieve compliance and framework, capability management, risk management, security controls and technology architecture design
  • Establish effective governance and control, in line with Business Transformation Framework and coordination of cross technology teams across Global Business and Global Function delivery
  • Work with the IT teams and Product Owner to drive improvements in productivity through backlog management, maturity in the use of Agile methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban and Lean, and corresponding management of dependencies

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline
  • Minimum 5 years+ on IT Project/Development/Devops working experience
  • In depth understanding on Java/Python development, SQL, Oracle, Redis/Hazelcast distributed cache system, Linux.
  • In depth understanding on CICD, Jenkins, Git, Jira/Confluence, Kubernetes, Docker/VM, Kafka(Distributed Message Queue).
  • Be proficient in Shell scripting, security protocol, Apache Gateway, TCP/IP network protocol, runtime Server Configurations, SSL Certificate setup and automation via SonarIQ, Nexus.
  • Knowledge of Istio(grpc) micro-services design and development, good understanding of spring core, spring boot and spring cloud framework.
  • Experienced at system analyze and architecture design, experienced at RESTful API design and development, idempotency, and data fault tolerance.
  • Experience with monitoring/troubleshooting skills and familiar with AppDynamic, Splunk and Grafana.
  • Understand basic front-end technology like HTML, CSS, Javascript, Ajax and web reactive frameworks/tools(React.js, Webpack, Redux) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks including JMeter and cucumber.
  • Proven experience in project management in an international financial institution
  • Proven experience in working with a global dispersed team
  • Good communication skills and an ability to collaborate with stakeholders
  • Proven troubleshoot ability for testing support, production support

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Payments knowledge would be an advantage
  • Knowledge in project management area will be the advantage
  • Knowledge in cloud native related experienced, especially in GCP

Job Board Tags

/51

/LP

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Head of AI Software Development .

Business: CTO Platforms

Job ID ： 37152

Principal Responsibilities

As a Director of AI Software Development, you will be a key technical leader responsible for executing the transformation of how the group develops software from inception to completion. You will lead and a grow a team of engineers to augment, transform and automate engineering product with AI capabilities that can be leveraged at scale by engineers across the group, fostering an engineering culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.

Your role will involve collaborating with product managers and cross-functional teams to shape strategy, define goals, and deliver engineering solutions. You'll be instrumental in problem-solving, making critical technical decisions, quality assurance, and evaluating emerging technologies to improve software development processes and outcomes.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

 Key Experience:

To be successful in this role you should have proven experience within the Technology sector with knowledge of the following:

  • L eading an engineering organisation, recruiting, inspiring and empowering developers with world-class technology, practice, and organisational enablement.
  • Transformation of developer products across the software development lifecycle, partnering with existing teams to embed AI within our products, in order to uplift both the engineering experience and productivity of our teams.
  • Strong Technical Background: In-depth knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture.
  • Experience with application of AI to software development patterns and processes to transform the way teams build products at scale
  • Evaluation and integrating: Evaluating AI proof of concepts in a standardised way, and iterating use cases through pilot phases to integrate with production products.
  • Product and Project Management: Experience in managing software development products and projects, including planning, resource allocation, and delivery.
  • Budgets and financial management: Ability to deliver to financial and commercial performance and hands-on experience of managing budgets and costs.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges effectively.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical concepts at all levels of the organisation.
  • Decision-Making: Demonstrated ability to make critical technical decisions and trade-offs while considering project constraints and business objectives.
  • Collaboration: Strong teamwork and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Key Technical Skills

  • Programming Languages: Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Golang, JavaScript or Ruby.
  • Software Architecture: Strong knowledge and experience in designing scalable, maintainable, and modular software architectures.
  • Deep technical and hands-on expertise with cloud platform technologies e.g., GCP, AWS, Alibaba cloud.
  • AI: Demonstrable experience of developing with AI, and using agents to augment and transform the software development process at scale
  • Controls: Demonstratable experience of working with IT controls, and automation of control compliance within products.
  • Audit: Build relationships and communicate with risk stewards, infosec and compliance partners to ensure close and continuous management of AI related change and risk factors

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4429786535.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: AI MS

Req ID: 48582

Location: Guangzhou TKH

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI-enabled applications, from initial discovery and solution scoping through prototype, production implementation, deployment, and adoption support.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational workflows, pain points, acceptance criteria, and measurable success outcomes.
  • Translate business requirements into practical AI / automation workflows, including LLM-powered features, RAG-based knowledge solutions, agentic workflows, APIs, and user-facing tools where appropriate.
  • Build production-grade software using technologies such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, backend services, APIs, databases, and modern web or integration frameworks.
  • Integrate AI / ML capabilities into enterprise applications, including prompt orchestration, retrieval pipelines, model APIs, evaluation logic, monitoring, and guardrails.
  • Collaborate with product managers, AI researchers, data scientists, platform engineers, cyber security, risk, compliance, and operations teams to ensure solutions are fit for enterprise deployment.
  • Design for reliability, maintainability, scalability, security, auditability, and responsible AI use in a regulated banking environment.
  • Support deployment activities including CI/CD, environment configuration, observability, performance tuning, incident troubleshooting, and production readiness reviews.
  • Gather feedback from real users and production telemetry to iterate on solution quality, model behavior, workflow usability, and business value.
  • Act as a technical thought partner to business teams, helping them understand AI capabilities, limitations, trade-offs, and responsible adoption patterns.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Around 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI engineering, LLM application engineering, machine learning engineering, data-intensive software engineering, or full-stack engineering with meaningful AI delivery exposure.
  • Strong practical understanding of modern AI / ML and LLM application architectures, including RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, model APIs, AI workflow orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or platforms, such as enterprise search, document intelligence, chatbot / assistant solutions, Text-to-SQL, agentic workflows, knowledge management, or workflow automation.
  • Strong programming capability in Python, with the ability to build reliable AI pipelines, backend services, integrations, evaluation scripts, and automation tools.
  • Solid software engineering capability in at least one additional application development language or ecosystem such as JavaScript / TypeScript, Java, or similar, with experience building APIs, services, UI components, or enterprise integrations.
  • Proven experience moving AI or data-driven solutions beyond proof of concept into production or production-like environments, including testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, deployment, support, and iterative improvement.
  • Ability to reason about AI system quality and trade-offs, including accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, retrieval quality, data privacy, security, observability, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate business workflows into AI solution designs and explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical users.
  • Strong ownership mindset, hands-on delivery attitude, and willingness to debug code, inspect data, tune prompts / retrieval logic, integrate systems, and unblock production delivery issues directly.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. /WX

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4469022688.descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • The Client Onboarding reviewer works in partnership with RM to get the client file to required standards of
  • SME Banking, will be responsible for assessing the risks of the client, provide assurance to the Business that the client file meets requirements and approve the file. Role comes with additional responsibilities to support the SME Banking network and international proposition.

Business

  • Business Enabling support to SME Banking Front Office for all Client Onboarding related matters. Main knowledge to support cross border account opening is critical.

Processes

  • KYC/ CDD Account Opening
  • Manage client approval end to end for the SME Banking files
  • Review New Account Opening Documentation for completeness and validity
  • Review accounts against all set internal standards for Client Due Diligence
  • Check quality of the Source of Wealth if it meets set standards for On-boarding
  • Conduct name screenings, adverse media findings, Sanctions links, Tax red flags
  • Ensure complete and accurate record keeping of all relevant communications
  • Ensure accuracy of data captured in SME system
  • Advise frontline on SME CDD policy and procedures and applicable local regulations
  • Escalate higher risk relationships and reputation risks arising from CDD to SME Compliance
  • Consult with functional experts (i.e. Legal, Compliance, Tax) as needed
  • Contribute to the implementation and controls for daily processes
  • Comply to agreed Turn Around Times for assigned activities as detailed in the Document Operating Instructions and the Service Level Agreements
  • Promote the spirit of continuous improvement by flagging any procedural issues that impact delivery of responsibilities with suggestions improvements and work around

People & Talent

  • Solid knowledge and understanding of regulatory requirements relating to SME Banking CDD/AML
  • Excellent verbal, presentation and written communication skills
  • People and service oriented. A team player.
  • High level of integrity and professionalism, with High attention to detail
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in SME banking sector in KYC/AML role

Risk Management

  • Execution responsibility for identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling, and mitigating financial crime risks, sanctions risks and reputational risks to the Group. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.

Governance

  • Group Procedures including Group CDD Standards, SME Banking Segment Addendum and Country Addendum as well as guidance and department operating instructions.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters

Skills And Experience

  • Manage Conduct
  • Manage Risk
  • Manage Stakeholders

Qualifications

  • ACAMS or ICA Certification would be preferred

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

Our Business

The Head of Trade in China is responsible for driving the growth agenda of trade in China at Bank of America. This includes the development and execution of the Trade Strategy in China from an end-to-end product management and product sales perspective in collaboration with Treasury Sales, Corporate Bank and the rest of the franchise. The Head of Trade will be leading a team of product and program management team as well as coordinate the specialized product sales team in China to deliver these results.

China is an important growth market for Global Payment Solutions GPS) at Bank of America and Trade and Supply Chain Finance is a critical component of GPS. Trade and Supply Chain Finance serve our financial institutions and corporate clients through a wide range of trade finance products ranging from traditional trade documentary trade to supply chain solutions and short-term export credit agency backed financing.

Responsibilities:

  • Development and execution of the China Trade Strategy in alignment with the Global and Regional Trade Strategies to achieve the Trade growth plans for China
  • Responsibility of the Trade Revenue plan, Trade Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet in China to ensure that the trade business meets all its required revenue and return targets. This also includes supporting regular revenue, balance sheet, and asset projections across Trade products in China.
  • Drive the Trade Specialized Product Sales (SPS) agenda in China overseeing the trade sales activity, pipeline development and execution in the market.
  • Partnering closely with Treasury Sales Officers, Corporate Bankers and regional SPS to identify priority clients and opportunities, manage client planning, originate new business and accelerate deal progression from origination through execution and revenue realization
  • Promote solutions-led approach to Trade Sales connecting traditional trade capabilities with broader working capital, payments, liquidity and foreign exchange considerations where relevant to deliver more holistic client solutions
  • End-to-end product development ensuring that all new product build and enhancements have a viable business case, built in the framework of our risk discipline and tracked for commercialization in collaboration with all business partners
  • Partner with Operations, Technology and other risk partners to maintain the on-going end-to-end product delivery model of existing products with discipline to ensure such products are continuously delivered with improved client experience and ease of doing business
  • Keep abreast of regulatory developments and changes in the China operating environment, assessing implications and opportunities for clients and the Trade business and communicating these to country and regional stakeholders. Work with risk partners on the implementation of required changes arising from such regulatory developments
  • Represent GPS Trade in relevant in-country governance forums, including business controls and risk management committees, and ensure appropriate oversight of matters affecting the Trade business
  • Coordinate Trade related regulatory and internal audit, compliance testing activity, working with relevant control and functional partners to ensure issues are addressed appropriately
  • Represent the bank as a Trade thought leader in external forums, industry discussions and client events, bringing perspectives on working capital, supply chains, trade flows and evolving market developments
  • Maintain competitive benchmarking of our trade products with our key competitors in order to identify product gaps, enhancements and plan to market
  • Act as the conduit between China and the regional and global Trade organization, sharing market opportunities and client insights, leveraging expertise across markets and supporting consistent regional and global sales execution on multinational opportunities.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership skills with over 10-15 years relevant trade finance experience in China who will be able to independently grow the trade business agenda.
  • Critical and strategic mindset required to develop a Trade China Strategy and Business Plan
  • Extensive sales and client management knowledge with clients operating in China and strong sales pipeline management discipline
  • Strong understanding of the whole spectrum of Trade Finance products across the working capital cycle and how to leverage such products to provide holistic solutions across cash and liquidity management, risk mitigation and FX.
  • Extensive analytical and financial acumen with experience in forecasting, balance sheet management, and performance reporting.
  • Knowledge of regulatory governance, risk management, and control frameworks affecting Trade products with experience in handling regulatory inspections and examinations and regulatory reporting
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across Product, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Sales, and Technology teams locally, regionally and globally.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Fluent written and spoken English and Chinese.

ln:4491170209.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • The role exists to ensure integrity, availability, control, and continuous improvement of critical Finance and Treasury data platforms and supporting infrastructure within the GFS Data Management portfolio. The role is accountable for maintaining robust information management capabilities that support financial reporting, regulatory obligations, operational decision-making, and business performance across the Bank.
  • The role develops and executes platform and data management roadmaps, ensuring that data controls, reconciliation processes, validation frameworks, and data quality standards operate effectively and consistently. It serves as the central point of accountability for service stability, infrastructure optimisation, risk management, and operational governance, enabling trusted and timely information for stakeholders.
  • Working across technology, finance, treasury, risk, and operational teams, the role influences strategic improvements to operating models, controls, and service management practices. Success is achieved through resilient information management capabilities, strong stakeholder partnerships, effective risk mitigation, and sustainable processes that support business continuity and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Information Management Strategy & Infrastructure Governance

  • Develop and maintain information management roadmaps that align data infrastructure capabilities with Finance and Treasury business priorities and regulatory requirements.
  • Govern the lifecycle of data management platforms, ensuring infrastructure resilience, scalability, performance, and long-term sustainability.
  • Drive the implementation of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and control frameworks that improve the reliability of critical financial information.
  • Evaluate emerging business requirements and control changes to enhance information management capabilities and service effectiveness.

Data Quality, Controls & Operational Integrity

  • Establish and maintain effective control frameworks that detect, prevent, and remediate data quality, reconciliation, and processing issues.
  • Monitor control effectiveness through metrics, KRIs, KCSAs, testing activities, and governance reviews to strengthen operational integrity.
  • Analyse control weaknesses, exceptions, and recurring issues to implement sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
  • Ensure dispensations, control deviations, and risk events are appropriately assessed, documented, escalated, and managed.

Service Management & Operational Resilience

  • Deliver stable and continuously available information management services through effective service management, monitoring, and operational support models.
  • Design and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience plans to minimise service disruption and data availability risks.
  • Optimise infrastructure performance through proactive monitoring, diagnostics, tuning, and capacity planning activities.
  • Manage configuration controls and operational dependencies to support service reliability and change readiness.

Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with Finance, Treasury, Technology, Risk, and Operations stakeholders to ensure information management services meet business needs.
  • Provide insight-driven recommendations using operational and performance data to support informed decision-making and prioritisation.
  • Communicate service performance, risks, issues, and improvement opportunities through clear governance and reporting mechanisms.
  • Influence stakeholders to drive standardisation, control enhancements, and consistent adoption of information management practices.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

  • Embed regulatory, operational, and conduct risk requirements into information management processes and services.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable policies, governance standards, financial control requirements, and risk management frameworks.
  • Identify, assess, escalate, and mitigate operational, technology, and information risks impacting business services.
  • Maintain effective governance processes that provide transparency, accountability, and assurance over information management activities.

Continuous Improvement & Operating Model Effectiveness

  • Drive process standardisation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, service quality, and control effectiveness.
  • Leverage performance metrics and management information to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Improve operating models through business process re-engineering, automation opportunities, and streamlined control execution.
  • Establish sustainable practices that improve service outcomes while reducing complexity and operational risk.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
  • Configuration Management
  • Infrastructure Optimization
  • Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Progress Reporting
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Strategic Planning

Motivations

  • Motivated by protecting customer and organisational data through practical, proportionate and sustainable privacy solutions.
  • Energised by solving complex risk and control challenges with stakeholders from different business, legal, compliance and technology disciplines.
  • Thrives in environments that value sound judgement, continuous improvement, collaboration and personal accountability.

Qualifications

  • Experience operating in complex financial services environments where data integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience are critical.
  • Exposure to enterprise data management platforms supporting Finance, Treasury, Risk, or regulatory reporting functions.
  • Experience working across technology and business teams to balance service stability, control requirements, and evolving business needs.
  • Exposure to governance frameworks involving risk management, control assessment, service assurance, and operational oversight.
  • Experience leading organisational change, process standardisation, and infrastructure optimisation initiatives in large-scale operating environments.
  • Business English (required)

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
